rows.note: Use this when a machine, system, or object is working properly; it is the default choice for sense 0.

example.english: The air conditioner is still functional.
example.jyutping: bou6 laang5 hei3 zung6 wan6 zok3 zing3 soeng4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is useful or designed for practical use rather than mainly decorative.

example.english: This bag is both attractive and functional.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 doi2 jau6 leng3 jau6 sat6 jung6

rows.note: Use this mainly in written or product-related descriptions of foods and drinks designed to provide physiological benefits.

example.english: This functional drink claims to help strengthen immunity.
example.traditional: 呢款功能性飲品標榜有助增強免疫力。
example.jyutping: ne1 fun2 gung1 nang4 sing3 jam2 ban2 biu1 bong2 jau5 zo6 zang1 koeng4 min5 jik6 lik6
